$comment: DAR Design — machine-readable architecture. Produced by inspecting the repository at branch feat/frontend-visual-overhaul @ 60dc112 on 2026-08-14. Every node carries `implemented` and `verified` flags; NEVER render a node with implemented:false as part of the live system.

project.name: DAR Design
project.tagline: Culturally grounded AI interior design for Arab domestic interiors
project.masterFlow: The LLM designs · DAR validates · the user edits · ControlNet + SDXL renders
project.masterFlowTechnical: LLM = Designer · DAR = Spatial Truth · Build Mode = User Control · ControlNet + SDXL = Renderer

cultures.note: Persian has ontology terms and a trigger phrase but NO trained LoRA, NO catalogue items, and is excluded from /redesign, Build Mode and the planner. Do not diagram it as supported.

project.$auditNote: Inspection began at 60dc112. Four commits landed DURING the audit (d80f03a, a4cec54, ab8d9b4, 2380fa8), adding real CC0 3D assets, a GLTF loader, PBR textures and procedural ornament. Every affected document was corrected; the pack describes 2380fa8. Still exactly ONE real model of 27 catalogue pieces.

nodeTypes.ai_ml: A learned model makes a judgement

nodes.label: User
nodes.description: Uploads a room photograph, writes a design brief, edits the 3D scene.

nodes.label: Studio
nodes.description: Upload → quota consume → /redesign → results. Three narrative tabs render; the six-tab ResultTab type in the source is dead code.

nodes.label: Depth Anything V2 Small
nodes.description: Monocular relative depth. DAR inverts its disparity so 0 = nearest.

nodes.label: OneFormer ADE20K Swin-L
nodes.description: 150-class semantic segmentation. ADE20K is the shared vocabulary with the seg ControlNet.

nodes.label: Room Analysis
nodes.description: Floor/wall/occupied/protected/free-floor masks, scale estimate from ASSUMED furniture widths, candidate placement spots. summary() contains NO room width/depth/height.
nodes.caveat: Scale estimation observed to fail badly in both directions (130 m² and 3.6 m² in one session).

nodes.label: Top-down + Region Projection
nodes.description: project_top_down() → object_map (cy is camera-axis depth). seg_bounding_boxes() → seg_regions (image space).

nodes.label: Cultural Ontology
nodes.heroPlacement: side rail feeding the prompt builder, the planner and the 3D materials — NOT a step in the pipeline
nodes.description: 113 curated terms: 4 cultures × 7 categories, EN + AR, each with a weight and a `verified` flag.
nodes.caveat: strict=True (which would exclude unverified terms) is passed by no production caller, so unverified Lebanese and Persian terms reach the generation prompt.

nodes.label: Furniture Catalogue
nodes.description: 27 items (9 per culture, 12 categories) with real centimetre dimensions, footprints, must_touch_wall and preferred_zones. Becomes the LLM's JSON-Schema enum.

nodes.label: Prompt Builder
nodes.description: Seeded weighted sampling from the ontology → bilingual positive/negative prompts + the LoRA trigger phrase. Same seed ⇒ same prompt.

nodes.label: LLM Design Planner
nodes.description: ONE call returns both `understood` (interpretation of the brief) and `items[]` (catalogue ids + positions). Emits NO dimensions and NO invented ids.

nodes.label: Rule-based Planner (fallback)
nodes.description: Deterministic layout when no LLM is configured or reachable. Tagged source:'rules'; the UI badge says 'Planned by DAR's rules'. CI runs this path.
nodes.verifiedBy: Exercised in production against a real 400 credit-balance error — the user still got a furnished room.

nodes.label: DAR Spatial Validator
nodes.heroEmphasis: PRIMARY — the most visually prominent element; draw as a hexagon
nodes.description: Oriented-rectangle separating-axis collision on the floor plane. Two-tier verdict: BLOCKING (out-of-bounds, overlaps a user-placed piece) refuses; ADVISORY (replaces-existing, needs-wall, blocks an opening) is stated but never refuses.
nodes.keyClaim: The SAME engine colours a human's drag ghost, explains the verdict, refuses a human's drop, and gates an AI plan.

gates.name: JSON-Schema enum
gates.effect: an invented catalogue id is UNREPRESENTABLE, enforced on both providers

gates.name: validate_items
gates.effect: dropped AND reported with distinct true reasons

gates.name: gatePlan → evaluatePlacement
gates.effect: oriented-rect SAT; one findSpot repair attempt; items validated IN ORDER against the growing scene

gates.name: opening keep-clear
gates.effect: door 90 cm / window 40 cm; advisory, not blocking

nodes.label: Room Derivation
nodes.description: Backs a floor area out of room_analysis and reconstructs object_map footprints as locked 'found' massing.
nodes.caveat: Room HEIGHT is always a 300 cm constant. Aspect ratio is always an assumed 1.25. Only AREA is estimated. Plausibility band 9-90 m²; outside it, a DEFAULT room labelled shellSource:'default'.

nodes.label: Build Mode (3D)
nodes.description: Metric three.js room in centimetres. Opens on a room reconstructed from the user's photograph, not an empty grid. 12 procedural geometry builders at real ontology dimensions; 22 ontology-sourced materials; snapshot undo/redo with gesture coalescing; localStorage persistence. 14 CC0 PBR texture sets whose colour maps are greyscale, so the ontology's per-culture palette survives and the surface only gains grain.
nodes.criticalFact: THREE HONESTY TIERS, all implemented and labelled in the UI: 1 of 27 catalogue pieces is a REAL MODEL (leb-ottoman-001, the CC0 Ottoman_01 scan from Poly Haven, uniformly 'contain'-fitted inside its declared collision box); 26 are ENHANCED PROCEDURAL authored geometry; objects read off the user's photograph are FALLBACK MASSING. Do NOT state 'no 3D models' and do NOT imply a large model library.

nodes.label: User Edits
nodes.description: Move, rotate, add, delete, duplicate, re-material, lock, resize the room, toggle the found layer. An entire AI plan applies as ONE gesture, so one Ctrl+Z removes all of it.

nodes.label: Depth + Segmentation Capture
nodes.description: Three offscreen passes from a purpose-built INTERIOR camera (eye 155 cm, FOV 54° ≈ 24 mm, walks in clear of furniture by 55 cm, keeps only the user's azimuth): beauty (sRGB, evidence), depth (NoToneMapping + Linear), segmentation (exact ADE20K palette).
nodes.keyClaim: Layout stops being something the model infers from a sentence and becomes something it is conditioned on.
nodes.verifiedBy: Segmentation output is pixel-exact against the backend palette (ceiling 120,120,80; wall 120,120,120).

nodes.label: ControlNet (depth)
nodes.description: Binds volume, distance, perspective and 3D silhouette. The stronger of the two.

nodes.label: ControlNet (segmentation)
nodes.description: Binds object identity and wall/floor/ceiling extents. Deliberately looser than depth, leaving the generator room to invent culturally appropriate surface inside the silhouette.
nodes.note: diffusers/controlnet-seg-sdxl-1.0 does not exist on the HF Hub; SargeZT's is the standard ControlNetModel-loadable SDXL seg checkpoint.

nodes.label: Cultural LoRA
nodes.heroPlacement: attached to / fused into SDXL — NOT a separate pipeline stage
nodes.description: One per culture, rank 16, 1500 steps, trained on a free Kaggle T4. Fused at lora_scale 0.8. All three files present on disk at 93,076,472 bytes each.
nodes.note: The Style Intensity Slider (/restyle) exposes lora_scale 0-1 directly — that is the LoRA ablation made interactive.

nodes.label: SDXL 1.0
nodes.description: The generator. Runs with the dual ControlNet and a fused cultural LoRA.

nodes.label: SD 1.5 + ControlNet 1.1 (OOM fallback)
nodes.description: On CUDA OOM, frees the SDXL pipeline and re-runs at 768². Code path exists; no OOM event has been observed in the recorded history.

nodes.label: Final Cultural Interior
nodes.description: A photorealistic render plus a manifest recording exactly which model, LoRA, seed and ControlNet weights ran.

notHeld: the appearance of any individual piece — the model invents surface and ornament inside the silhouette; materials reach it through the prompt, so they steer rather than bind

nodes.label: Render Host (Kaggle T4)
nodes.description: Ephemeral GPU host behind a rotating tunnel. NO users table, sent NO session cookie, holds no durable state.

nodes.label: Data Host
nodes.description: The developer's own machine. SQLite + images/, and the LLM API key. Falls back to API_URL when unset.

nodes.label: SQLite
nodes.description: WAL mode, foreign keys ON. Evaluation scores are COLUMNS on the history row, not a side table — so deleting a design removes it from every average in the same instant.

nodes.label: Explainability Truth Gate
nodes.description: adapters.ts returns null rather than degrade, never falls back to demo data, and emits unmeasured values as {value:null, measured:false} — rendered as an em-dash, never a zero.

nodes.label: Evaluation System
nodes.description: SSIM (hand-rolled on numpy+scipy, matching skimage to 1e-9), LPIPS, CLIP zero-shot culture recognition, coverage denominators, one shared SQL filter builder.
nodes.criticalCaveat: IMPLEMENTED but almost UNMEASURED. SSIM n=3, duration n=4, human ratings n=2. LPIPS, CLIP and the confusion matrix hold ZERO data — the lpips and open_clip packages are not installed. NEVER attach a metric value to any diagram.

nodes.label: RAG / Vector Store / Embeddings
nodes.renderAs: OMIT, or draw dashed at 40% opacity inside a box explicitly labelled NOT IMPLEMENTED
nodes.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. No retrieval, no embedding model, no vector store, no chunking, no similarity search over cultural knowledge. Verified by repo-wide search and by the absence of any such dependency in either requirements file.
nodes.insteadUses: A curated ontology indexed by culture key (O(1) dict lookup) plus a closed catalogue enforced as a JSON-Schema enum.
nodes.note: backend/guardrails.py::filter_chunk mentions 'RAG chunks' in its docstring, but its only production caller applies it to static ontology JSON entries. It is a defensive sanitiser, not retrieval.

nodes.label: Real 3D Assets (CC0)
nodes.renderAs: draw normally, but label the ratio: 1 real scan of 27 pieces
nodes.description: IMPLEMENTED as of 2026-08-14 (commits a4cec54, ab8d9b4). ONE real model: public/models/Ottoman_01.glb (651 KB, CC0-1.0, Caspian Fortune, Poly Haven) bound to catalogue id leb-ottoman-001 via the sidecar registry ontology/furniture_models.json. Loaded by src/lib/design/modelLoader.ts with GLTFLoader. The other 26 catalogue pieces remain enhanced procedural geometry.
nodes.whyOnlyOne: There is no CC0 library of Lebanese, Khaleeji or Moroccan furniture. ~20 candidate scans were inspected against DAR's catalogue art and all but one were rejected as culturally wrong. DAR's own LoRA-generated catalogue art is more culturally specific than anything available under CC0.
loadBearingRules: The visual may never outgrow the collision box — uniform 'contain' scale only, because placement.ts collides the catalogue's declared rectangle and the inspector, minimap and planner all quote those numbers.
Nothing unclassified may reach the segmentation pass — loading is async, so the swap re-stamps userData.ade across the whole subtree, and a procedural stand-in is on screen from frame one.

nodes.label: LoRA-vs-Baseline Ablation Results
nodes.renderAs: dashed — the code path exists, the data does not
nodes.description: automatic_metrics() splits eval/results.csv by arm and computes deltas. eval/results.csv DOES NOT EXIST; evaluation_results holds 0 rows; outputs/ is empty. The panel was removed from the page rather than shown permanently empty.

edges.label: one depth+seg pass, whatever the culture count
no key / provider error / call cap
validated placements + a list of what was refused
positive + negative prompts, EN/AR, + trigger phrase
fused into the UNet at scale 0.8

heroFlow.caption: It starts with a photograph of a real room.
Two models read it — depth and semantic segmentation.
Cultural knowledge is a curated, auditable file, not something the model recalls.
The model reads the brief and proposes pieces from a fixed catalogue.
And here is the point: DAR decides whether that is allowed — with the same collision engine that judges a human's drag.
The user gets a real, metric, editable 3D room.
Because it is 3D, DAR can produce the exact two control images the generator already used.
So the layout is not described to the model — it is imposed on it.

heroBypass.label: Studio path — Build Mode is optional
heroBypass.note: REQUIRED in the hero diagram. Without it the diagram wrongly implies every render passes through the 3D editor.

forbiddenInDiagrams: Any RAG, vector store, embedding or retriever node outside a clearly-marked NOT IMPLEMENTED box
Any numeric metric value (SSIM, LPIPS, CLIP, accuracy, percentages) — almost none are measured
Persian shown as a supported culture
Six Studio result tabs — that type is dead code; only three narrative tabs render
Time-of-day or sun simulation as a Build Mode feature — that is /v2, a different route
The retired /upload + /transform + /status + /result polling flow presented as live
The cultural ontology drawn as a step in the pipeline rather than a side rail
A "3D model library" node implying many assets — there is exactly ONE real CC0 model out of 27 catalogue pieces; label the ratio or omit the node
Stating that DAR has no 3D models — that was true before 2026-08-14 and is now wrong
